mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by > 0.5% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong quarterly GDP growth signals sustained economic momentum and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 2.5% and the regime is late-cycle, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in inflation signals the central bank may tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise > 0.5pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO fall > 1.0% in 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a stabilization in the federal funds rate signals the central bank may pause hikes, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS stabilizes (change < 0.1pp in 1 month) during a monetary tightening cycle, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts signal robust consumer spending and economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
